title: Generate Valid Action Sequences
real_world_story: An AI workflow engine generates sequences of opening and closing actions. A generated sequence is valid only when every opening action is properly matched by a closing action and no closing action appears before its corresponding opening action.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Backtracking to construct valid sequences while maintaining the number of available opening and closing actions

problem_statement: Given an integer N, generate all valid sequences containing N pairs of parentheses. A sequence is valid if every opening parenthesis is matched with a closing parenthesis and no prefix contains more closing parentheses than opening parentheses.
task: Generate all valid balanced parentheses sequences containing exactly N pairs.
input_format: The input contains a single integer N.
output_format: Print all valid sequences in lexicographical order, separated by spaces. If N is 0, print an empty sequence.

examples.explanation: There are two valid sequences containing two pairs of parentheses.
There are five valid sequences containing three pairs of parentheses.

expected_algorithm.name: Generate Parentheses
expected_algorithm.reason: Backtracking can generate only valid sequences by adding an opening parenthesis when available and a closing parenthesis only when it does not make the sequence invalid.

hint: Track the number of opening parentheses already used.
Track the number of closing parentheses already used.
An opening parenthesis can be added while fewer than N openings have been used.
A closing parenthesis can be added only when the number of closings is smaller than the number of openings.
real_world_takeaway: Backtracking can generate valid action sequences by constructing candidates incrementally and preventing invalid states from being explored.
